## Batch 56 complete

The draft A/B pages contain 19 items: 14 A-page items and five examples. The 1D SUPG form and proofs now retain the full diffusion residual on smooth trial functions. The page also includes a TikZ checkerboard diagram.

Scoped checks passed: content policy (19 items), strict proof contracts (19/19), precheck (13 proof-bearing items), proof layout (49 steps), rendercheck (21 files), focused depcheck, and source coverage (26 results; 4/4 sources fetched). Batch dependency levels recompute with zero errors and a maximum level of 4.

## Open escalations

- `thm-supg-one-dimensional-energy-error` remains escalated because its published interpolation supplier, `lem-one-dimensional-p1-interpolation-error`, still has `verification.precheck: pending`.
- Batch 41’s energy-stable Navier–Stokes page now has draft items. Its relevant theorem, `thm-na-mini-be-step-existence-energy`, fails precheck with `untagged-steps`; its recorded dependency level is 0 but computes to 8. The page-level prerequisite remains owner-escalated. No batch 56 claim uses that theorem.
- The whole-run dependency scan reports 31 errors outside batch 56: eight empty page inventories and 23 stale dependency-level labels. Batch 56 has no errors in that scan.
- Eighteen items have current `ready` records. I preserved the energy-error escalation; its stored hash predates a later norm-domain clarification and does not match the current carrier, so it remains open for owner review.

The live run remains at Step 1 scaffold, 43/71 coverage, with no active workers and the existing owner repair and recertification blocker. I left autopilot state and other batches untouched.
